scope: Nonblocking CL:SLEEP in scheduled dual-compiled Lisp; ordinary synchronous calls retain their blocking implementation.

implementation.dispatch: Resumable alternate for SYSTEM:ENVIRONMENT-OP intercepts SLEEP; other operations delegate unchanged, including multiple values.
implementation.wait: Host timer parks the task; zero seconds also waits for a host turn. Re-check the deadline and chunk long timers at 2147483647ms.
implementation.cancellation: Clear the timer in generator cleanup, then unwind Lisp callers; caller cleanup can itself sleep.

coverage: Other tasks and host callback progress before a 30ms sleep finishes
Cancellation clears a long host timer and unwinds caller; fake timer verifies 2147483647ms chunk
Zero sleep yields; unrelated DECODE keeps all 9 multiple values; ordinary zero sleep still works

node.command: npm --prefix tests run build:resumable && npm --prefix tests run test:resumable

browser.scope: Load and supplied API assertions; GUI verification is separate

browserReproduction: Concatenate performance/resumable.lisp, resumable/checks.lisp, callbacks.lisp, scheduler.lisp, eval.lisp, synchronization.lisp, sleep.lisp and alexandria-checks.lisp. Run probe.mjs alexandria REPORT CHECKS --browser valtan-resumable --after-load=AFTER. AFTER concatenates the four portable scheduler/eval/synchronization/sleep check modules and awaits each verifier; disable fileCompilation for browser EVAL.
remaining: Public Bordeaux Threads APIs, lifecycle/join/interrupt and default bindings require an adapter.
Application drivers still need scheduled entry points.
Other blocking host operations, load-time initializers, native error delivery and arbitrary foreign callbacks remain synchronous boundaries.
Older live McCLIM/Drei snapshots do not verify this change.
